title: Dented white van seen at the facility and followed
place_text: Maryland, near the training facility and the Holiday Inn

tellings.quote: it. I looked at the white band that I saw at the exit and sure enough it had that same exact uh dent.

plain: Sometime between 1990 and 1993 in Maryland, a white van with a dent in it turned up near a training facility and then seemed to be following him near his Holiday Inn, says Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that listens in on communications, hired him to talk with aliens. He tells it as something he saw himself. He says he checked the van he spotted at the hotel exit against the one from the facility, and it had "that same exact uh dent". If true, it would mean someone was keeping watch on him during that work.
